newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom gets Moldavia licence.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom gets Moldavia licence.

text.p: France Telecom said in a statement its FTMI unit had obtained a GSM mobile telecommunications licence in Moldavia.
The licence was awarded to the Start consortium in which FTMI has a 51 percent stake.
Other partners were Moldavian Mobile Telephone with 35 percent, Moldtelecom with 10 percent and Romania's Mobil Rom with four percent.
FTMI has a majority stake in Mobil Rom.
It said that there were currently 570,000 fixed telephone subscribers in Moldavia which has a population of 4.4 million, or a penetration rate of 13 percent.
It expects to have 150,000 subscribers to its mobile service before 2007. The Start consortium will invest $60 million in the first 10 years.
